name: University of Patras
summary: Patras public university; its one English-taught degree is a fee-paying six-year Medicine programme with 50 places a year.

handoff.label: English Medical Studies Program: how to apply

ib.text: The IB Diploma counts as your high school diploma (20% of the selection score); no points or subjects are stated. CV, English and an interview make up the rest.

lastYear.text: apply by 29 July; regulations say due each June

programmes.name: English Medical Studies Program
programmes.about: Six-year medical degree in English (360 ECTS): four preclinical semesters with clinical skills in simulation, clinical semesters 5 to 10, then clinical practice at the Patras University General Hospital, with Greek lessons in the first six semesters.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma accepted as the school certificate, no points or subjects stated; last two school years abroad; B2 English or TOEFL 79; CV, personal statement and interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Out of 105: diploma 20, CV 25, English 30, interview 30; the top 50 are admitted if they score above 80 (study regulations, not yet updated for 2027).

lastYear.text: apply by 29 July; regulations say due each June

notes: Only foreign nationals who did their last two school years outside Greece can apply; you pay a €100 application fee to have the file assessed.
The regulations say five scholarships are awarded each year on academic and financial criteria, announced separately.
